quickExit.label: Quick exit
quickExit.hint: Leaves this site immediately and clears this page. Shortcut: Shift + Esc.

display.title: Display and reading
display.wideLettersHint: Can make reading easier, for example with dyslexia
display.colours: Colours: light, dark or eye care
display.discreetHint: The browser tab shows "Notes" instead of SpeakSafe

readAloud.noUrdu: This device has no Urdu voice installed. You can add one in your phone or computer's speech settings.

idle.title: Are you still there?
idle.body: To protect your privacy, your space will lock in about a minute. Anything you saved stays safe.

home.title: A safe place to speak up.
home.intro: Take your time. Nothing is shared until you choose.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.p1: No email, phone or real name needed
privacy.p2: Your IP address is not stored
privacy.p3: Everything is encrypted on your device

how.title: How SpeakSafe works
how.s1b: A made-up username and a password. No email or real name.
how.s2b: Keep a private journal and evidence. Nothing is shared.
how.s3b: Choose who can read it, and whether they know who you are.

help.title: Need help now?
help.body: If you are in danger, call:

err.username: Use 3 to 32 lower-case letters or numbers, with single hyphens between them.
err.passwordWeak: This password is easy to guess. Try three or more random words.
err.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.

signup.title: Create your private space
signup.intro: One place for your journal, reports and messages. Only you can open it.
signup.usernameHint: We made one up for you. Please don't use your real name.
signup.passwordHint: Tip: three or more random words are easy to remember and hard to guess.
signup.privacyNote: No email, no phone number, no real name. Even if you report as Anonymous, the committee never sees your username.
signup.wordsIntro: If you forget your password, these 6 words are the only way back in.
signup.wordsWarning: Write them on paper and keep them somewhere safe. Nobody can recover them for you, not even us. That is what keeps your space private.
signup.checkTitle: Quick check: type word {{a}} and word {{b}}
signup.checkHint: Type the two words above to continue.

login.title: Welcome back
login.intro: Log in to your private space.
login.missing: Please enter your username and password.
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Use your recovery words
login.sharedNote: On a shared device? Your space locks itself after 10 minutes without activity.

recover.title: Use your recovery words
recover.intro: Type your username and your 6 recovery words, then choose a new password.
recover.wordsHint: Tip: paste all six words into the first box.
recover.badWord: Word {{n}} isn't one of the recovery words we use. Please check the spelling.

space.title: You're doing the right thing by being here.
space.welcomeNew: Your private space is ready. Keep your recovery words safe.
space.recovered: Your new password is set. You were logged out everywhere else.
space.sub: Take things one step at a time. You can stop and come back whenever you like.
space.safe1: Only your password can unlock what you save here.
space.safe2: The committee never sees your username.
space.safe3: Keep your 6 recovery words somewhere safe.

break.title: Take a moment
break.intro: There's no rush. Breathe with the circle.
break.pattern: In for 4 · hold for 4 · out for 6
break.talk: Talk to someone: support and helplines

placeholder.soon: This section is coming in the next build step.

errors.network: We can't reach SpeakSafe right now. Please check your internet connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

authShell.title: Your story stays yours.
authShell.body: SpeakSafe locks everything on your own device before it is sent. Only the people you choose can read your report.
authShell.foot: Free and confidential. Leave any time with Quick exit.
